facts.claim: Manmad had a population of 7,113 in 1901.
facts.quote: Population (1901), 7*113. Manmad is the junction of the Dhond- Manmad State Railway with the Great Indian Peninsula Railway, and also the starting-point of a metre-gauge railway to Hyderabad.

facts.claim: Cotton from Khandesh and Malegaon was transported by rail through Manmad.
facts.quote: Much cotton from Khandesh and Malegaon is carried by rail here.

facts.claim: Nandgaon had a population of 6,271 in 1901.
facts.quote: Population (1901), 6,271. The town contains a cotton-ginning factory, an English school, and a dispensary.
